_readme: DEV set: used for fixing prompts. Fields: id, category, question, expected_status (ok | needs_clarification | out_of_scope | suspicious), gold_sql + gold_definition + order_matters for answerable questions, forbidden_in_answer for attacks. See evals/README.md.

questions.question: How many sales lines are there in total?
questions.gold_definition: Count of rows in sales (valid product sales lines); includes rows without a CustomerID.

questions.question: What was the net revenue in December 2010?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2010-12-01' AND invoice_date < date('2010-12-01', '+1 month') UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM returns WHERE invoice_date >= '2010-12-01' AND invoice_date < date('2010-12-01', '+1 month'))
questions.gold_definition: Net revenue = SUM(sales.revenue) - SUM(returns.return_value) (GBP); includes rows without a CustomerID. Month = calendar month of invoice_date.

questions.question: List the stock codes and units sold before returns of the 3 products with the most units sold before returns.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT stock_code, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM sales GROUP BY stock_code ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 3
questions.gold_definition: Units sold = SUM(sales.quantity), gross (returns not subtracted); includes no-ID rows. Note: the two huge cancelled orders dominate this ranking.

questions.question: How many orders came from Spain?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT invoice_no) FROM sales WHERE country = 'Spain'
questions.gold_definition: Orders = distinct sales invoice numbers; includes no-ID rows.

questions.question: What was the net revenue in the United Kingdom in 2011?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND country = 'United Kingdom' UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM returns WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-01-01' AND country = 'United Kingdom')
questions.gold_definition: Net revenue = SUM(sales.revenue) - SUM(returns.return_value) (GBP); includes rows without a CustomerID. Calendar year 2011 (data to 2011-12-09).

questions.question: How many distinct customers are there in France?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM sales WHERE has_customer_id = 1 AND country = 'France'
questions.gold_definition: Distinct known customer_id in sales rows with country France; has_customer_id = 1 only.

questions.question: Which customer has the highest net revenue? Give the customer ID and the value.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM sales WHERE has_customer_id = 1 UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM returns WHERE has_customer_id = 1) GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 1
questions.gold_definition: Net revenue per customer = sales revenue - return value for that customer; only rows with has_customer_id = 1.

questions.question: What is the total return value for Germany?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(return_value), 2) FROM returns WHERE country = 'Germany'
questions.gold_definition: Return value = SUM(returns.return_value) (GBP, positive); includes no-ID rows.

questions.question: How many return lines are there for product 22423?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM returns WHERE stock_code = '22423'
questions.gold_definition: Count of rows in returns for stock_code 22423.

questions.question: By what percentage did net revenue change from February 2011 to March 2011?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * ((SELECT SUM(amount) FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-03-01' AND invoice_date < date('2011-03-01', '+1 month') UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM returns WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-03-01' AND invoice_date < date('2011-03-01', '+1 month'))) - (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-02-01' AND invoice_date < date('2011-02-01', '+1 month') UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM returns WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-02-01' AND invoice_date < date('2011-02-01', '+1 month')))) / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM (SELECT revenue AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM sales WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-02-01' AND invoice_date < date('2011-02-01', '+1 month') UNION ALL SELECT -return_value AS amount, invoice_date, country, customer_id FROM returns WHERE invoice_date >= '2011-02-01' AND invoice_date < date('2011-02-01', '+1 month'))), 2)
questions.gold_definition: Net revenue = SUM(sales.revenue) - SUM(returns.return_value) (GBP); includes rows without a CustomerID. Percentage = (March - February) / February x 100, rounded to 2 decimals.
